topic: Pipelining and Forwarding Before Register Writes
explanation: Processor pipelining improves instruction execution speed by overlapping the stages of instruction processing.  Forwarding is a technique used to resolve data hazards, where an instruction needs the result of a preceding instruction that hasn't yet written its result back to the register file.  Without forwarding, the pipeline would stall, reducing performance. Forwarding allows the result to be passed directly from one pipeline stage to another, avoiding the stall.
